learner_operation: Identify inner polynomial u and outer exponent +1/2 or -1/2; differentiate each, multiply, simplify, and where requested substitute x0. Select the matching expression or enter an equivalent expression.

fixed_features.feature: Outer function is square root or reciprocal square root; inner polynomial degree at most two
fixed_features.justification: Lesson e-182, q-48730 and q-342680 establish this chain-rule depth; sum term only in q-20181.

fixed_features.feature: Finite real slope and simple square radicand for evaluated questions
fixed_features.justification: Source slopes all evaluate at positive square radicands. Avoiding undefined roots preserves the stated derivative task and arithmetic workload.

fixed_features.feature: One correct expression in a five-option radio or equivalent-expression blank
fixed_features.justification: Captured field contracts; zero-total radio bank must be rejected to keep five distinct choices.

shortcut_probes.strategy: Compute only 3*k*t^2; choose numeric option nearest it. Do not differentiate the radical.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: The original 20/20 bypass now succeeds 4/20. All options hold the cubic contribution fixed and vary the radical contribution. Native outcomes were checked.

delivery.result: 150 independently chosen raw records; 58 fresh records survive the reviewed band at basis 5048. Five deterministic runner records are retained. Role coverage and visible-cue probes are recorded separately before and after filtering.

limitations: Finite tests do not prove absence of every shortcut.
Learner selection is conditional on fresh eligible candidates and a positive weight for the reviewed band; real history and future IDs were not simulated as fact.
Only moderate receives this publication certificate; other advertised bands require their own certificate.
Source omissions and explicit source corrections are retained in source-analysis.json. Canonical missing answer widgets are authored completions, not recovered historical fields.
